title: Clean up a scanned contract
promise: Scan a paper document, make it searchable, shrink it, and put your signature on it.
audience: Freelancers and small teams with paperwork to send back
note: This trail is about file handling only. It is not legal advice, and a signature image on a PDF is not a certified digital signature. Check what the other party requires.

steps.title: Scan and straighten the pages
steps.why: NAPS2 drives most scanners, straightens pages and saves a single PDF, which is easier than stitching phone photos together.

steps.title: Make the text searchable
steps.why: OCRmyPDF adds a text layer under the scan so you can search and copy from it. It is a command-line tool; NAPS2 can also OCR as it scans if you would rather skip this step.

steps.title: Compress the file
steps.why: Scans are big. PDF24's free tools shrink a PDF enough to fit through most email attachment limits.

steps.title: Sign it
steps.why: Adobe Acrobat Reader's free Fill & Sign lets you type, draw or place an image of your signature and add the date.
